Hi Jordan —

Thanks for signing up for Redwood's self-serve trial — welcome! I’m Irene on the growth team and I run quick intro sessions for new accounts to make sure the trial maps to your use case.

Quick options: a 20–30 minute product tour (what's in the platform, routing/options, and a short Q&A) or a 45 minute technical runthrough that covers inference profiles and cost controls. If you just want to poke around on your own, no problem — this is optional.

If you'd like the short tour, pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min?hs=acmeops

I attached a one-pager and a draft MA/SLA that other customers frequently request during procurement.

Attachments: redwood-product-one-pager.pdf (1 page), ma-sla-draft.docx (draft)

Next steps (suggested):
- Confirm whether you prefer Product Tour (30m) or Technical (45m)
- Choose a slot via the Calendly link above OR reply with two good windows (include timezone) and I’ll propose one of them

If you have a specific technical contact you'd like on the call, loop them in.

Thanks —
Irene Choi
Sr. Growth Manager | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

---
NOTE: This message was sent from my mailbox as a manual handoff after your signup to ensure a human point of contact. If you prefer purely automated scheduling, the Calendly link works without replies.
